k1.author: seed
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) with the application dict; it returns a dict.

k2.author: seed
k2.text: In API v1 the response has `decision` (approve or decline) and `limit` (integer).

k3.author: seed
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}; action `issue` uses the returned limit, action `decline` has limit 0.

k4.author: worker-B
k4.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k4.text: API v1 decision field can be "approve", "decline" or "refer"; "refer" means not decided → map to action "queue_review" (do not decline).

k5.author: worker-B
k5.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 7000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k5.text: Network referral rule: for any partner, if applicant is self_employed AND requested_limit > 7000, route to queue_review instead of issuing. A decline stays a decline (rule does not override decline).

k6.author: worker-B
k6.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k6.text: Calloway spec: svc.apply(app) takes fields id, age, income, employment (employed|self_employed), requested_limit; returns {decision: approve|decline|refer, limit: int, 0 unless approved}. approve→issue with returned limit; decline→decline; refer→queue_review (do not decline).

k7.author: worker-B
k7.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 7000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k7.text: Network referral rule detail: applies "whatever the partner decided" — self_employed + requested_limit > 7000 forces queue_review for an approve, but a decline stays a decline (do NOT convert decline to queue_review).

k8.author: worker-B
k8.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed. outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
k8.text: Calloway API v2 (current): svc.apply returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved"|"declined"|"manual_review", "credit_limit": int}}. v1 fields decision/limit are removed. Map approved→issue with credit_limit; declined→decline; manual_review→queue_review (replaces v1 "refer").

k9.author: worker-B
k9.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 7000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k9.text: Ordering in handler: check decline first (stays decline even if self_employed >7000), then manual_review, then apply network referral rule to approved (self_employed + requested_limit > 7000 → queue_review).
